exposure: Fetal Doppler pulsatility indices (umbilical artery PI, middle cerebral artery PI, ductus venosus PI)
cohort: The participants were 48 neonates born from pregnancies complicated by fetal growth restriction (FGR), diagnosed based on abdominal circumference or estimated fetal weight < 10th percentile or declining fetal growth.
finding: Fetal arterial Doppler measurements, particularly those indicating brain sparing, are associated with the quality of neonatal general movements 1 week after birth, but this association is no longer evident at 3 months post-term.
birth_weight: Estimated fetal weight < 10th percentile or declining fetal growth of at least 30 percentiles
